verification_report.summary: The proof is correct within the bounded scope and accepted standard inputs. The puncture lemma is valid by two successive one-variable maximum-principle arguments. The incidence model, exceptional bundle and section, Hermitian norm, Poincaré–Lelong identity, Fubini–Study constants, blow-up Jacobian, and smooth positive extension of dV_Y all check exactly. The class is big and non-nef; rho=2 log s has minimal singularities, full mass one, and finite classical E^1 energy. Non-pluripolar locality gives the stated equation, [BEGZ Corollary 2.3](https://arxiv.org/html/0812.3674v2) yields uniqueness with zero full-mass error, the internal ample-locus theorem gives Amp(alpha)=Y\E, and the first-exit path argument proves incompleteness on every nonempty connected open subset. The BEGZ citations match their applications. [DNGL Question 3.5 and Section 3.1](https://arxiv.org/html/2607.08325v1) confirm that this answers the unrestricted big-class completeness question while correctly leaving nef classes and flow-compatible data unresolved.
